title: Smooth vector bundles from a smooth linear cocycle
statement: Let $N$ be a smooth real manifold [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], let $q\geq0$, and put $F=\mathbf R^q$ with its Euclidean norm. A smooth vector bundle core consists of a set $I$, open sets $U_i$ covering $N$, a choice $\sigma(p)\in I$ with $p\in U_{\sigma(p)}$ for every $p\in N$, and maps $T_{ij}:N\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf R,\mathrm{cont}}(F)$, smooth on $U_i\cap U_j$ in the operator topology, such that $T_{ii}(p)=1$ on $U_i$ and $T_{jk}(p)T_{ij}(p)=T_{ik}(p)$ on $U_i\cap U_j\cap U_k$. Values outside the indicated overlaps are arbitrary. No continuity of $\sigma$ is imposed. Define its bundle to be the bundle with fibre $F$ at each $p$, total space the set $\{(p,v):p\in N,\ v\in F\}$, projection $(p,v)\mapsto p$, and the topology and local trivializations supplied by the vector-bundle-core construction. Its $i$-th trivialization is $(p,v)\mapsto(p,T_{\sigma(p),i}(p)v)$ over $U_i$, and its coordinate change from $i$ to $j$ is $T_{ij}$. The construction is a smooth rank-$q$ real vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle].
